name: aabha-ai
description: Aabha AI - Cognitive Healthcare & Memory Companion Platform

scripts.install:all: npm install --prefix backend && npm install --prefix frontend
scripts.build: npm run build:backend && npm run build:frontend
scripts.build:frontend: cd frontend && npm install && npm run build
scripts.build:backend: cd backend && npm install && npx prisma generate && (npx prisma db push --accept-data-loss || true) && npm run build
